public.title: Delete your ISPC Fácil account
public.intro: You can delete your account at any time, directly in the app or on the website.
public.step1: Sign in to your ISPC Fácil account (app or website).
public.step2: Open the menu and choose "My Profile".
public.step3: Under "Delete account", type DELETE and confirm with the code sent to your e-mail.
public.step4: The account is deleted after 30 days. Until then you can cancel by signing in again.
public.deletedText: name, e-mail, phone, assistant conversations and access to companies.
public.keptText: tax documents issued (invoices, receipts, credit notes) and audit records, for 10 years, as required by law.
